citation.title: Time series regression network using exogenous variables for missing effective ion charge reconstruction in EAST tokamak
citation.authors: K. Jia, Z. Xu, Z.W. Wu, W. Gao, et al. and the EAST Team

topic: Offline ML reconstruction of a missing diagnostic signal (line-averaged Zeff from visible bremsstrahlung) on EAST from exogenous plasma signals
own_question: Can missing or unreliable Zeff segments or whole shots be reconstructed post-discharge from 16 other plasma parameters?
actual_method_and_evidence: The model is a CNN-BiGRU-Transformer encoder. It processes non-overlapping 1000 ms flat-top windows at 1 kHz. Inputs include offline-EFIT quantities. Labels are Zeff values smoothed with a Savitzky-Golay filter (59 points). The authors report a chronological 80/20 split of 1566 discharges (2023–2024). The 20% portion is divided into validation and test sets, but the exact proportions are not stated. Hyperparameters were tuned on validation MSE. Reported test results are R2 0.952, mean similarity 90.3% and coverage 91.4% (validation and test combined). Comparisons are against ablated deep-learning variants only. There is no comparison with hold-last-value, interpolation or Gaussian-process baselines.

claim_checks.allowed_intro_or_theory_claim: ML has been used for offline reconstruction of missing tokamak diagnostic signals, such as Zeff on EAST, from other measured plasma parameters.
claim_checks.qualification: Bidirectional and offline-EFIT-based; the authors state it is not intended for real-time use. Zeff is distinct from impurity CES Ti. The labels are conventional measurements, not independent physical truth.

claim_checks.allowed_intro_or_theory_claim: Chronological splitting has been used to approximate application to later discharges from the same device.
claim_checks.qualification: This is a single campaign period with no untouched external data. The authors themselves note that distribution shift remains a risk.

input_target_timing_if_relevant: Inputs are two-sided within each window (BiGRU and self-attention) and include offline EFIT quantities. The task is noncausal reconstruction of the concurrent signal, not causal nowcasting or future prediction. Report arrival times are not addressed.
validation_if_relevant: Chronological 80/20 split; the validation/test proportions within the 20% are unknown. No persistence or interpolation baselines. Overall uncertainty in measured Zeff is about ±20%. The coverage band is defined by each shot's Zeff standard deviation, not by diagnostic uncertainty.
forbidden_inferences: That causal or online nowcasting was demonstrated
That this result applies to CES impurity Ti, KSTAR, BES or ECEI
That all prior reconstruction work is noncausal
That the SHAP results or the loop-voltage–resistivity reasoning establish a physical mechanism
That the deep model outperforms simple temporal baselines
reason_to_include_or_exclude: Include as a contrasting example of offline, two-sided missing-signal reconstruction. It helps motivate our causal, current-report setting and our use of simple temporal baselines. It should not serve as evidence of performance for our task.
